subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection always display the most constrained recognized quota, including an exhausted family, or preserve a usable family when one remains available?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible user-facing contracts, and the patch intentionally replaces the existing usable-window fallback; tests cannot determine which product meaning maintainers want.

options.title: Show the binding quota
options.body: Use the most-used recognized five-hour or weekly quota consistently across automatic menu-bar display and highest-usage ranking, even when that family is exhausted.

options.title: Preserve a usable family
options.body: Continue excluding exhausted families while another Antigravity family remains usable, retaining current upgrade behavior.

options.title: Use context-specific semantics
options.body: Surface exhausted quotas in reset-focused output but use a usable family for percentage and cross-provider ranking contexts.

recommendation.title: Show the binding quota
recommendation.body: Use the most-used recognized five-hour or weekly quota consistently across automatic menu-bar display and highest-usage ranking, even when that family is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner was directly asked to settle this user-visible contract and has merger history for the underlying Antigravity quota feature.
